notes:
Apex 2.1.0.0 - Guild Fest run by Apex

- Guild Fest is now run by Apex on every account (Settings > Events > Guild Fest > "Guild Fest run by": Apex / Engine / Off). In Apex mode the engine's own Guild Fest is switched off and Apex picks, takes, does, submits and claims.
- Apex reads the quest board and takes only cards that are ticked, within your Take above / Max points, and that the account can finish. The card's Complete missions switch turns this on or off.
- Quests Apex does itself: Labyrinth (Elite / Normal / Use Holy Stars), Kingdom Tycoon (Spend Luck Tokens, Meet a Gemming Gremlin, including the gremlin's capsules), Spend Artifact Coins (x10 / x1 chest opens), Upgrade / Enhance Artifacts, Spend Gems (the item you choose), and Complete Guild / Admin Quests (uses a Quest Scroll when the quest list runs dry).
- Completed quests are submitted, Solo Rewards are claimed, and Guild Rewards tiers are collected, all under the one "Claim rewards" switch.
- Gems are never spent unless you switch it on: "Allow spending gems", "Buy luck tokens with gems" and "Buy quest scrolls with gems" are all off by default, and "Keep at least this many gems" is a floor no buy goes below. Packs already in the bag (Holy Stars, luck tokens, quest scrolls) are used first.
- Every Guild Fest action Apex takes is written to the account's Log tab.
